profile.headline: Software Engineer (Ex-Color, Cisco)
profile.summary:
Software engineer. 2020 graduate with B.S. in Computer Science.

Skills: Python, NodeJS, HTML/CSS/JS, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices, Django, ReactJS, Git, C++/C, SQL,  MongoDB, GCP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Drove the development of an AI-driven ad campaign generation pipeline which leveraged prompt engineering and ChatGPT API to create high-performing ads, reducing time spent by internal media buyers on campaign creation by 70%.
* Designed an Ad Compliance review tool that streamlined the review process, reducing manual review time for internal compliance analysts and increasing the number of ads reviewed by the team from 50 to 250 ads per day.
* Built an intelligent web crawler to analyze competitors' ad campaigns which extracted insights on current trends in the ad marketing space, enabling internal media buyers to leverage real-time competitive intelligence for campaign optimization.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Flask · MySQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Retool

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Optimized SEO performance of client’s website and landing pages, leading to a 40% growth in customer traffic
* Developed a fully responsive web application for the client's sports team, providing a platform for client’s coaches to share updates and information with players and staff.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Django · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Engineered streamlined data model interfaces in partnership with cross-functional teams, optimizing data model utilization and boosting developer efficiency by 35%
* Implemented an address validation API into company’s logistics operations, reducing the number of invalid shipments made by 90%
positions.insights: Skills: Django · ReactJS · PostgreSQL · Software Design · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Automating complex use cases for new features to help with testing efficiency and issue visibility, resulting in early issue detection which improved product quality
* Collaborating with a team of engineers on research and development of emerging technologies to enhance testing approach which reduced manual intervention and lowered company costs
* Building tools to capture and consolidate metrics from sources such as Elasticsearch, Prometheus, and Grafana which greatly improved cloud observability
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Elasticsearch · Kibana · Selenium

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Developed a fully responsive web application based on RESTful architecture for the company's clinical trial which allowed patients to track their progress in the trial.
* Assisted in deploying web application by utilizing GCP Compute Engine API to set up server instance
positions.insights: Skills: Nodejs · Bootstrap · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · SQL · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Integrated Slack API to receive notifications whenever a customer made a specific action on the web platform which greatly helped with Customer Success and bug tracking
* Utilized Elasticsearch and Kibana to visualize platform data on dashboards which improved understanding of software analytics.
* Made design improvements to software interface which made the platform easier to navigate for users
positions.insights: Skills: Elasticsearch · Kibana · Django · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · ReactJS

positions.title: Operations Coordinator
positions.description:
* Supported larger team in event operations including furniture and audiovisual setups, strikes and change overs
* Optimized setup and takedown workflows by maintaining clean, organized storage rooms
* Ensured smooth guest experiences by posting directional signage

positions.title: IT Intern, Mobile
positions.description:
* Set up mobile devices for doctors during rollout of hospital-wide mobile app
* Trained 10 doctors on mobile device and app usage
* Promoted app usage to patients through in-person engagement and creation of marketing collateral
* Developed public-facing web pages on Kaiser Permanente website for various departments
